title: Named rule register (unverified) and AfriSam policy-gap entry
scope: Extend the legal-route registry with named candidate entries from the framework rule library, all unverified pending RSL Legal, and seed the policy-gap register with the absence of a codified arm's-length standard

acceptance.text: Candidate entries for related-party allocation (Income Tax Act 1993 s.113 as limited by AfriSam), input VAT evidence (VAT Act 2001; VAT (E-Invoicing) Regulations 2026), imported services, WHT and treaty rates, thin capitalisation, record production, refund handling and data use; each is verification_status unverified with no invented section numbers, dates or reviewers
Unverified entries are visible to officers as candidate routes but the gate still blocks assessment-type progression until a reviewer verifies them; findings map to these entries by finding code
Policy-gap register seeded with the arm's-length gap linked to the BP6 related-party scenario; tests show unverified routes never pass the gate and the policy-gap entry is produced
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Policy-gap register seeded with the arm's-length gap linked to the BP6 related-party scenario; tests show unverified routes never pass the gate and the policy-gap entry is produced

evidence.text: ai/workflows/rule_register.candidates.json: candidate entries for related-party allocation (s.113 as limited by AfriSam), deduction test, input VAT evidence, imported-services VAT, WHT and treaty rates, thin capitalisation, employment/PAYE, record production, refund handling and data use; all unverified, no added section numbers, dates or reviewers.

rule_register.py loader refuses verified or reviewed entries; route_for always returns eligible_for_assessment False (candidate_unverified / policy_gap / no_candidate); TAX-118 pipeline maps every finding code through it.

ai/workflows/policy_gap_register.json GAP-ARMS-LENGTH linked to related_party_interest_free_loan (BP6, ai/tools/related_party_signals.py); RuleRegisterTests show unverified routes never eligible and the gap is produced.
